final: SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as proj_count, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) * 1.0 / 980 as share, (COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) * 1.0 / 980) - (1.0 / 3) as above_avg FROM scanqc WHERE archstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY archstat HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) * 1.0 / 980 > (1.0 / 3) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) * 1.0 / 980 DESC
